sentence: A social deduction word game where everyone except one hidden imposter is dealt a secret Netflix show, players give one short clue per round for two rounds, then vote on who the imposter is.
use_when: A group wants a quick party game in the chat
Someone asks to play imposter or a spot-the-faker word game
People want a Netflix or TV show themed guessing game
A group wants to bluff and vote on who is faking
dont_use_when: Only two people are present, since it needs at least 3 players
The group wants a different theme or custom word list
The group wants a simple poll or a vote on a decision rather than a game
